mapper.sql: FROM sales_order d JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.order_id = d.id LEFT JOIN item it ON it.id = i.item_id LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id = d.customer_id

sql.if: AND (it.item_code LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{q.itemKeyword}) || '%' OR it.item_name LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{q.itemKeyword}) || '%')

mapper.select:
SELECT i.id, d.id AS doc_id, d.doc_no, d.doc_date, d.status, c.customer_name, i.line_no, i.item_id, it.item_code, it.item_name, i.spec_snapshot AS spec, i.unit, i.ordered_qty AS quantity, i.unit_price, i.tax_rate, i.amount, i.tax_amount, i.tax_inclusive_total
WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY d.doc_date DESC, d.doc_no DESC, i.line_no
